exposure: repeated doses of vaginal PGE2 (Dinoprostone, Prostin)
cohort: 885 women with singleton live fetuses admitted to the labor ward for induction of labor by vaginal PGE2 at a teaching university hospital in Jordan from January 2015 to December 2016, classified by parity (primigravid and multiparous).
finding: In primigravid women, more than two doses of PGE2 was associated with a higher rate of cesarean section, while in multiparous women, a third dose of PGE2 was not associated with a higher rate of cesarean section.
mod_finding: Primigravid women who received more than two doses of PGE2 were more likely to have a cesarean section (65.5%) compared with those who received two or fewer doses (42.9%).
